decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.371. Series context: trend strength 0.9911 and seasonal strength 0.3059; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.431); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 59.376.
